newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Germany's Rexrodt says mark-US$ level good.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Germany's Rexrodt says mark-US$ level good.

text.p: German Economics Minister Guenter Rexrodt said there was a relatively good relationship between the mark and the U.S. dollar at the moment which would help boost German exports.

"If you look around there is a relatively good relationship between the deutschemark and the dollar and there are very good export possibilities. The export comanies are booming in Germany," Rexrodt told reporters in Melbourne.
He was there to plant a tree at the site for the new Australian headquarters of German electronics group Siemens.
Rexrodt also said German interest rates were at historical low and at 2.5 percent growth, the economy was performing well for a mature economy.

"Interest rates in Germany are at an historical low level," he said. "Never have they been on such a low level as they are for the time being. The overall circumstances for more growth - and we have 2.5 percent which is not bad - are promising."
